title: mimi-00: credential identity is userUri (JM-1)
description: Mark decided (via mimid-13, 2026-10-18): mimi-00 §keypackage and Room/create rule 2 call the credential identity a 'client URI bound to the account'. mimid keeps credential identity = user URI (H1) and binds clients by a derived client URI from the leaf signature key. Reword so a user-URI credential conforms: the KeyPackage leaf is bound to the account by its signature key; the credential identity is the userUri.
